evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup, including profile and history, number of employees, and list and description of off-the-shelf or custom products and services offered.

Bench/roster description required showing range of expertise, vetting and development processes, quality assurance, and resource assignment process.
